name: com.google.android.ads.mediationtestsuite.activities.AdUnitDetailActivity
description: Google Mobile Ads Mediation Test Suite opens this screen after a developer selects an ad unit. It lists that unit's mediation network configurations and can load test ads from selected networks.
disableEffect: Developers can no longer inspect or batch-test an ad unit's mediation sources here; regular ad delivery is unaffected.
